attrs.evidence: None. GPT-5.6's answer to R7.1 §5, and it is a WEAKENING that makes the goal reachable rather than a concession that gives it up. R7.1 asked whether LINEAGE-COMPLETE survives model inference. It does not survive at R7.1's wording — `every semantic dependency` reads as every weight and activation without which the output would differ, which is mechanistic interpretability and is not available. What IS achievable is channel completeness. A model is ONE support node, an attested ModelRef, not a billion; the envelope is model identity, context, system instructions, tool definitions, retrieved inputs, tool results, decoding configuration, randomness, substrate identity and external side inputs. The question a revocation worklist asks is `could this result have been admitted without passing through this support object?`, which is a provenance question and not a mechanistic one. THE CLOSED-WORLD PROPERTY IS THEREFORE NOT `nothing external exists` BUT `nothing may influence an admitted result invisibly`.
attrs.gap: Nothing in this tree mediates anything. LINEAGE-COMPLETE keeps its id and its wording and is superseded rather than renamed, because a claim_id preserves proposition identity and `semantic dependency` and `permitted channel` are different propositions. SUPERSEDED AT R7.3 AND NOT RENAMED. GPT-5.6 ruled that `permitted` is the wrong load-bearing word and that the property belongs on the admission boundary. Taken, and split in two, because the single sentence contains one proposition a gate can check and one it cannot. The channel catalog is retained and PROMOTED: it is the quantifier domain of ADMISSION-SUPPORT-NONBYPASSABLE, carried by ASM-MEDIATION-UNIVERSE, not descriptive coverage.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, on ROUND7_1_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md §5. Channel capture at this granularity is routine in LLM tracing (OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions; MLflow), which establishes feasibility and not completeness. Bazel sandboxing for the build-system half.

readjudicated.method: question_survives — an OPEN claim asserts nothing that could transfer; the question is re-posed against the target tree
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: The load-bearing word is `permitted`. Channel completeness is a property of the ADMISSION GATE, not of the model: it holds when every channel that could influence a result must pass through a mediated handle that records an edge. A world that leaves one ambient channel open has no completeness at all, and the count of channels is not the measure — one unmediated read is enough.
attrs.statement: Every channel permitted to influence an admitted transition is either represented by a typed support edge or the transition is inadmissible.
